// Proof Style compiles to FRAMES ONLY. Nothing in this file may
// reach the lexicon, the symbol registry, or the validators —
// the golden test asserts exactly that.

= 3. Universal Language Rules

== 3.2 Proof Transitions

ALWAYS use `Hence` for the final concluding sentence.
NEVER use `Therefore` or `Then` as the final closing sentence.

== 3.3 Proof Closing

ALWAYS write "In all cases" — NEVER "Hence" to close a proof
by cases.
